description.value:
You channel enhancing energy into a willing droid. For the duration, the target's speed doubles, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, and it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional droid per slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
